visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male toddler with short dark hair, wearing a dark green sweater and jeans, stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. In the background, a black gaming chair with skull-patterned cushions and a window with blinds are visible. The child holds a small blue toy and looks towards the camera with a curious, wide-eyed expression. (2) The scene cuts to a hallway with light-colored walls and a wooden floor. A woman in a grey long-sleeved shirt and blue jeans crouches on the floor, holding a plush ET doll dressed in a blue hoodie. The toddler, now wearing a grey hooded sweatshirt, stands a few feet away, looking at the doll with suspicion. (3) In a flashback-style sequence, the same child is seen lying in a black and grey stroller. A hand reaches in holding the ET doll, and the child touches the doll's finger. The lighting is warm and natural. Text overlays appear at the top of the frame. (4) Back in the hallway, the woman moves the doll closer to the child. The toddler reacts by flailing his arms and stepping back, his face contorting into a cry of fear. Another woman is partially visible in the doorway in the background, watching the interaction. (5) The setting shifts to a modern kitchen with white cabinets and a grey countertop. A woman in a white button-down shirt is seen placing the ET doll inside one of the lower cabinets. Kitchen appliances like a toaster, microwave, and coffee maker are visible on the counter. (6) The toddler approaches the kitchen cabinet and pulls the handle. As the door opens, he sees the doll tucked inside. He immediately freezes, lets out a high-pitched cry, and runs away from the cabinet toward the woman in the white shirt for comfort. (7) A series of quick cuts show the child attempting to open different cabinets throughout the kitchen. Each time he opens a door, the doll is found in a different position. The child's reactions range from startled silence to frantic crying as he repeatedly encounters the doll. (8) The video concludes with the toddler being hugged by the woman in the white shirt. He looks distressed but is being comforted. An inset circular video shows one of the women laughing heartily at the child's reactions. The kitchen remains the primary background setting with bright, flat lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A sharp, high-pitched child's scream pierces the silence, characterized by high vocal arousal and negative valence. The background music (BGM) is a whimsical, mid-tempo orchestral piece featuring light woodwinds and strings, creating a comedic atmosphere. No ambient noise is detected, suggesting a studio-clean or post-produced audio track. (2) A heavy thud follows as a wooden cabinet door is slammed shut. A female voice enters with a moderate speech rate and a friendly, teasing tone, speaking in Mandarin Chinese. The BGM continues with a rhythmic staccato pattern, emphasizing the playful nature of the "prank" being performed on the child. (3) The sound of rapid, light footsteps on a hard floor indicates the child running away. This is followed by a series of "No" exclamations from the child in a high-pitched, strained voice. The BGM swells slightly in volume, featuring more prominent synthesizer textures and a steady beat of approximately 124 BPM. (4) A sequence of mechanical clicks and soft thuds occurs as multiple cabinets are opened and closed in quick succession. Intermittent bursts of female laughter are heard in the background, exhibiting a bright spectral centroid and high intensity. The BGM maintains its mischievous tone throughout these rhythmic sound events. (5) The child's crying transitions into soft whimpering with a breathy vocal texture. The female narrator's voice becomes calmer and more professional, though still carrying a hint of amusement. The audio track ends with a final musical flourish and a soft ambient room tone, signaling the conclusion of the scene.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Setup -> Repetitive Climax -> Comforting Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a humorous family interaction where a mother uses a toy the child is afraid of to prevent him from repeatedly opening kitchen cabinets. The video relies on the comedic contrast between the child's dramatic reactions and the adults' playful teasing.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: No specific products are promoted; the focus is entirely on the child's reaction to a common toy used as a prank.
